orders.emptyBody: Orders customers place arrive here with the day and window they asked for.
orders.filteredEmptyBody: Clear the status filter or the order-number search to see the whole book.
orders.caption: Orders placed against this kitchen
orders.searchHint: Part of an order number, for example 0148.
orders.detailLoadErrorTitle: This order could not be read

orders.conflictTitle: This order changed while you were working on it

orders.cancelBody: Cancelling is final — the order cannot be confirmed or fulfilled afterwards.

reason.addressUnreachable: The address could not be reached

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.subtitle: What corporate buyers have asked this kitchen to price, newest first — name a figure against every line and send it back.
quotations.emptyBody: When a corporate buyer submits a request against one of this kitchen's programmes, it arrives here.
quotations.filteredEmptyBody: Show all to see every request this kitchen has received.
quotations.caption: Quotations submitted against this kitchen
quotations.detailLoadErrorTitle: This quotation could not be read
quotations.linePriceHint: The price of one unit, in {{currency}}.
quotations.linePriceInvalid: Enter an amount with no more decimal places than the currency has.
quotations.guidanceBody: Prices are in {{currency}}, which the buyer's agreement fixed — you are not choosing it. Sending is refused until every line carries a price; zero is accepted.
quotations.conflictTitle: This quotation changed while you were working on it
quotations.conflictBody: Somebody else priced it. Refresh to read where it stands now, then try again.
quotations.staleBody: This quotation was accepted, declined or has expired, so prices can no longer be sent for it. Refresh to see where it stands.

stock.title: Stock
stock.subtitle: On-hand quantities per branch and the movement ledger — no valuation in this phase.
stock.emptyBody: Stock follows your ingredients and the products you buy in — add one of those and it appears here.
stock.ingredientsHint: Everything you can cook with. Received, counted and consumed by the recipes that use it.
stock.ingredientsEmptyBody: Add an ingredient and it gets a shelf here straight away.
stock.productsHint: Products you buy in rather than make. A sale takes one off the shelf.
stock.productsEmptyBody: Mark a product as supplied rather than made, and it appears here.
stock.noLevels: Nothing on hand at this branch yet.
stock.adjustHint: Enter how much to add or remove.
stock.fieldThresholdHint: Flag as low when on-hand falls to or below this. Leave blank for no threshold.
stock.fieldParLevelHint: The level to restock back up to.
stock.lowStockCount_one: {{count}} item at or below its reorder point
stock.lowStockCount_other: {{count}} items at or below their reorder point

procurement.noSuppliers: No suppliers listed for this organisation yet.
procurement.postFailed: The receipt could not be posted.
procurement.newSupplierFailed: The supplier could not be added.

ledger.emptyBody: Posted goods receipts appear here, newest first, once stock has been received.

production.emptyBody: Create a batch from a published recipe version. Completed batches show here with their status.
production.createFailed: The batch could not be created.
production.versionHint: Paste the published version id from the recipe editor.
production.noBranchBody: Production batches are branch-scoped. Select a branch in the workspace picker.
production.loadErrorTitle: Production orders could not be loaded
production.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.

qc.emptyBody: Open a check against a goods receipt or production batch, then hold or release it.
qc.createFailed: The check could not be opened.
qc.subjectIdHint: The goods receipt or production order id to inspect.
qc.loadErrorTitle: Quality checks could not be loaded
qc.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.

costReport.title: Monthly cost report
costReport.subtitle: Purchasing spend and cost of goods sold beside the month's selling — real figures, and the margin between them.
costReport.emptyBody: Once stock is received and orders confirmed, each month's spend, cost and selling appear here.
costReport.dataQualityTitle: This month's COGS may be understated
costReport.dataQualityBody_one: One month has unresolved consumption exceptions, so its cost of goods sold is understated.
costReport.dataQualityBody_other: {{count}} months have unresolved consumption exceptions, so their cost of goods sold is understated.
costReport.caption: Monthly cost report

exceptions.title: Consumption exceptions
exceptions.subtitle: Sales a confirmed order could not deduct from stock honestly. Fix the cause and retry, or resolve one you have accepted.
exceptions.emptyBody: When a confirmed order cannot deduct a line — no recipe, no stock item, not enough stock — it appears here instead of guessing a quantity.

reasons.no_stock_item: No stock item at the branch

kds.title: Kitchen display
kds.subtitle: Every open ticket for this kitchen, longest wait first. The board refreshes itself while it is on screen.
kds.emptyBody: Orders placed against this kitchen appear here the moment they arrive.
kds.loadErrorTitle: The board could not be loaded
kds.conflictTitle: A ticket moved while it was on screen
kds.conflictBody: Another station started or finished it. Refresh the board to see where it stands now.
kds.noBranchBody: Choose the branch this screen is displaying before the board can show its tickets.

driver.subtitle: Every job assigned to you that is still live, oldest first. The list refreshes itself while it is on screen.
driver.loadErrorTitle: Your deliveries could not be loaded
driver.emptyBody: Jobs appear here the moment dispatch assigns one to you.
driver.deliverBody: This tells the kitchen the customer has the order. It cannot be undone from here.
driver.notesHint: Who took it, where you left it — anything the kitchen would need if the customer calls.

tracking.awaiting_assignment: Customer told: waiting for a driver

review.title: Needs review
review.subtitle: What is stopping this catalogue from going out, across every family that can hold something back.
review.summaryBlocked_one: One of them cannot be published at all until the reason is resolved.
review.summaryBlocked_other: {{count}} of them cannot be published at all until the reasons are resolved.
review.summaryUnblocked: None of them is blocked outright — this is work to finish, not a wall.
review.reasonDerivationStale: Figures out of date since the last change
review.reasonInconsistentPrices_one: {{count}} price entry breaks the amount rule
review.reasonInconsistentPrices_other: {{count}} price entries break the amount rule
review.reasonMissingTranslation: One language of the name is still empty
review.clearBody: No record in this kitchen is quarantined, out of date, or missing something that would stop it being published.
review.scope: Checked: allergen quarantines, out-of-date recipe figures, price entries that break the amount rule, unverified allergen mappings, unresolved import findings, and names missing a language.
review.notChecked: Not checked here: delivery zones and opening hours, which have no publication state to hold anything back, and the allergen classes, which the platform owns.
review.truncatedTitle: More records match than are shown
review.truncatedBody: At least one family filled the page this queue reads. Open that family and filter it by status to see the rest.
review.errorTitle: The review queue could not be loaded

list.title: Ingredients
list.subtitle: The shared library plus everything this kitchen has added or changed.
list.caption: Ingredients
list.emptyTitle: This kitchen has no ingredients yet
list.emptyBody: Add the first one, or wait for the import to bring the library in.
list.filteredEmptyBody: Try a shorter search, or allow more statuses.
list.missingArabicHint: This record has no Arabic name yet, so it cannot be published.
list.archiveFailed: That ingredient could not be archived.

editor.createdToast: {{name}} was created, and can be used right away.
editor.saveError: Those changes could not be saved.
editor.nameRequired: An English name is required before this can be saved.
editor.archiveBody: It disappears from every consumer surface and stays on the recipes and cost records that already point at it. Nothing is deleted.
editor.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date, or the record belongs to another kitchen.
editor.loadErrorTitle: That ingredient could not be loaded
editor.platformLibraryTitle: This is a platform library ingredient
editor.platformLibraryBody: Name, classification and other names are shared across kitchens and cannot be edited here. Allergen mappings can still be strengthened — use Save the mapping in that section.

bilingual.englishHint: Written left to right, whatever language the interface is in.
bilingual.arabicHint: Written right to left, whatever language the interface is in.
bilingual.missingArabicHint: A draft saves without it; publication does not.

fields.name: Name
fields.referenceHint: The code on the delivery note, for example IG-014.
fields.categoryHint: Where it sits in the kitchen's own grouping.
fields.unitHint: The unit this ingredient is bought and issued in.
fields.notesHint: Anything the next person needs to know. Never a substitute for an allergen mapping.

aliases.title: Other names
aliases.description: Designations seen on delivery notes and technical sheets. The import matches on these.

allergens.title: Allergen mapping
allergens.description: What this ingredient contains, and how well established each determination is.
allergens.safetyTitle: Changing a mapping changes a published label
allergens.safetyBody: Every recipe and meal that derives an allergen from this ingredient is re-labelled. Dropping one that a published recipe relies on puts both records into review, and neither can be published until a person resolves it.
allergens.empty: No allergen has been mapped to this ingredient.
allergens.emptyHint: An empty mapping is a claim that it carries none. Say so deliberately.
allergens.marketScopeHint: Leave empty when the mapping applies everywhere.
allergens.evidenceHint: The supplier specification, the test report or the person who confirmed it.
allergens.platformBaselineHint: The platform library records this. A kitchen may strengthen it, never weaken it.
allergens.upgradeOnlyContainment: A platform baseline may not be weakened from “contains” to “may contain”.
allergens.upgradeOnlyVerification: A platform baseline verification may only be strengthened.
allergens.saveBlocked: Resolve the marked rows before saving.
allergens.chooseClass: Choose a class for every row.
allergens.saveError: The allergen mapping could not be saved.
allergens.quarantineTitle: This ingredient is now awaiting review
allergens.quarantineBody: The change contradicts a published label, so the record and everything that derives from it are held back from publication until somebody resolves it.
allergens.classesError: The allergen classes could not be loaded, so no mapping can be edited.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this record
conflict.body: It was saved by somebody else while this was open, so saving now would overwrite their work. Reload to take their version, or keep editing and copy your changes out first.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.body: This record has changes that have not been saved. Leaving now discards them.

classes.title: Allergen classes
classes.subtitle: The regulatory vocabulary an ingredient is mapped onto.
classes.governanceTitle: These are managed by the platform
classes.governanceBody: A class code is a regulatory identity: it is never renamed, never deleted and never invented here. A kitchen owns its own mappings onto these classes and nothing else.
classes.noMarkets: No market in this list requires it
classes.emptyBody: The platform reference data has not been seeded for this environment.
classes.errorTitle: The allergen classes could not be loaded

a11y.aliasAdded: {{alias}} was added to the other names.
a11y.mappingAdded: An allergen mapping row was added.
a11y.mappingRemoved: An allergen mapping row was removed.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.subtitle: The formulations this kitchen cooks from. Every change opens a version; only a published one reaches a plate.
recipes.caption: Recipes
recipes.emptyTitle: This kitchen has no recipes yet
recipes.emptyBody: Write the first one, or wait for the import to bring the technical sheets in.
recipes.filteredEmptyBody: Try a shorter search, or allow more statuses.
recipes.archiveBody: Nothing is deleted. The recipe and its versions stay for the meals, products and cost records that point at them; it simply disappears from every consumer surface.
recipes.archiveFailed: That recipe could not be withdrawn.
recipes.saveFailed: The recipe could not be saved.
recipes.notFoundBody: That address does not name a recipe in this kitchen.
recipes.loadErrorTitle: This recipe could not be loaded
recipes.confidentialHint: Formulations and costs live here and on no consumer surface.
recipes.nameRequired: A recipe needs an English name.
recipes.yieldDescription: How much one run of this version makes, and how much of it is lost on the way.
recipes.yieldRequired: The yield must be a number greater than zero.
recipes.yieldPiecesHint: Leave empty when the yield is not countable.
recipes.wastePercentHint: Process loss. The source sheets state three per cent.
recipes.versionsDescription: A published version never changes. Editing one opens its successor, and consumers keep reading the published one until that successor is published in turn.
recipes.versionUnavailableTitle: This version's contents cannot be loaded
recipes.versionUnavailableBody: The management API answers with the current version in full and every other one as a summary. Its number, its state and its publication date are shown; its lines are not available to read.
recipes.immutableTitle: This version is published and cannot be changed
recipes.immutableBody: Open a new draft from it. The draft starts as a copy — lines, outputs and method — and consumers keep reading the published version until the draft is published in turn.
recipes.newDraftFromVersion: Create a new draft from this version
recipes.createHintBody: Lines, outputs and the method are edited once the recipe exists and has its first draft version.
recipes.linesDescription: What goes in, in the order the sheet lists it. The same ingredient may appear twice.
recipes.linesEmpty: No lines yet. A recipe cannot be published without at least one.
recipes.lineUnitUnknownDimension: Choose an ingredient to narrow the units to the ones it can be converted to.
recipes.lineNoteHint: Kept verbatim beside the resolved ingredient, so the original designation is never lost.
recipes.outputsExplainerBody: An output makes this version's product stockable as an ingredient: a pesto mix or a demi-glace becomes a line another recipe can use.
recipes.outputsEmpty: No outputs. This version produces a dish, not a stock item.
recipes.primaryOutputHint: Exactly one output of a version may be the primary one.
recipes.primaryOutputRequired: Choose which output is the primary one.
recipes.stepsDescription: The method, in both languages. The order they are in is the order they are carried out in.
recipes.stepMinutesHint: How long this step takes. Leave empty when it does not matter.

publish.title: Publish this version?
publish.body: Publishing makes this version the one every consumer surface reads.
publish.consequence: The recipe, its figures and the allergen rows below become visible on the menu, in search and on every meal built from it. The version is immutable from then on.
publish.allergenRowsTitle: The label this version would carry
publish.allergenRowsNone: No allergen is derived from these lines.
publish.quarantineBody: This recipe’s allergen information contradicts a determination it was published against. Publication is refused from here — no amount of clicking gets past it. Resolve the conflict on the ingredient first.
publish.blockedTitle: This version cannot be published yet
publish.blockName: The name is missing one of its two languages.
publish.blockDescription: The description is missing one of its two languages.
publish.blockUnsaved: There are unsaved changes. Save them first — publishing publishes what the server holds, not what is on screen.
publish.blockIngredientState: {{name}} is {{status}}, so a label derived from it cannot be published.
publish.unmappedTitle: Some ingredients carry no allergen determination
publish.unmappedBody: An ingredient with no mapping is either genuinely free of all fourteen classes or has never been checked, and this record cannot tell the two apart. Open each one and record the determination before this label is trusted.

rollup.title: What this draft declares
rollup.description: Computed from the lines beside it. Nothing here is stored until the draft is.
rollup.empty: Add a line to see the figures.
rollup.errorTitle: These lines could not be rolled up
rollup.staleErrorTitle: The figures below belong to the previous draft
rollup.allergensNone: No allergen is derived from these lines.
rollup.allergenProvenanceHint: Press a code to see the lines that put it there.
rollup.allergenNoSources: No line was recorded as the source.
rollup.costHint: Purchase cost including waste. It exists on this screen and on no consumer surface.
rollup.warningUnknownIngredient: A line points at an ingredient that is not in the library.
rollup.warningUnconvertibleUnit: A line is measured in a unit that cannot be converted to a mass here, so it was left out of the figures.
rollup.warningMissingCost: At least one ingredient has no recorded cost, so no total is shown.
rollup.warningMissingFacts: At least one ingredient carries no reference facts, so it was left out of the figures.
rollup.unsavedNotice: This preview stores nothing. Save the draft to keep it.

channels.sectionHint: Every channel is listed, including the ones this product is not sold through — “not sold here” is a decision, and an absent row would look like an unanswered question.
channels.fromHint: Leave empty for “as soon as it is published”.
channels.saveError: Those channels could not be saved.
channels.createFirst: Save the product first. Channels are set on a record that exists.

availability.explainerBody: This is what the catalogue stores: a date, whether the meal can be ordered on it, how many portions are left and when same-day orders close. There is no weekly rule here because there is no column for one — a repeating pattern would be an interface promising something the kitchen record cannot hold.
availability.empty: No days have been set, so this meal has no availability of its own.
availability.dateRequired: Choose the date this row is about.
availability.dateDuplicate: That date already has a row. Two answers to one day is one too many.
availability.availableLabel: Can be ordered on this day
availability.remainingHint: Leave empty when the kitchen does not count portions. Empty is not zero.
availability.remainingInvalid: Portions left must be a whole number, or empty.
availability.cutOffHint: Branch-local, 24-hour. Empty inherits the branch’s cut-off for that weekday.
availability.cutOffInvalid: Write the cut-off as HH:mm, or leave it empty.
availability.saveError: That availability could not be saved.
availability.createFirst: Save the meal first. Availability is set on a record that exists.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: What this kitchen sells by the pack, rather than as a dish on a menu.
products.caption: Products
products.emptyTitle: This kitchen sells no products yet
products.emptyBody: Add the first one, or wait for the import to bring the product list in.
products.filteredEmptyBody: Try a shorter search, or allow more statuses.
products.archiveBody: It leaves every sales channel it is on. Nothing is deleted: price lists and past orders still point at it.
products.archiveConsequence: Archiving is the only lifecycle action this catalogue publishes for a product. There is no way to put it back from here.
products.archiveFailed: That product could not be archived.
products.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date, or the record belongs to another kitchen.
products.loadErrorTitle: That product could not be loaded
products.nameRequired: An English name is required before this can be saved.
products.categoryHint: The codes this kitchen already uses. There is no category editor yet.
products.marketPricedLabel: Priced at the day’s market rate
products.marketPricedHint: A market-priced product carries no confirmed price. Its price-list entry records the absence rather than a number nobody agreed.
products.assortedHint: For a row that is genuinely “assorted” rather than one article. The members are not invented into products that do not exist.
products.packsHint: The first pack is the default one, and moving a pack to the top is what changes that. Prices point at a pack by its code.
products.packsEmpty: No packs yet. A product with no pack cannot be priced.
products.packCodeHint: Stable within the product. A price list quotes this code, so renaming it orphans the price.
products.packCodeDuplicate: Two packs share this code, so a price could not say which it meant.
products.packQuantityInvalid: Net quantity must be a number greater than zero.
products.unitsPerPackHint: A tray of twelve is 12; a single bottle is 1.
products.unitsPerPackInvalid: Units per pack must be a whole number of at least one.
products.recipeHint: A product is either cooked here or bought in. Linking the recipe is what lets its allergen and diet information follow the formulation instead of being retyped.
products.recipeNoneHint: This product is bought in rather than cooked, so nothing is derived from a recipe.
products.dietsProvenance: Read from the linked recipe’s published version. There is no product-level override on this catalogue.
products.dataQualityTitle: The import left findings on this row
products.dataQualityBody: Each flag is something the import could not resolve on its own. They stay until somebody decides what the right answer is.
products.quarantineBody: This product’s allergen information contradicts a determination it was published against. Resolve the conflict on the ingredient; nothing on this screen can clear it.
products.archivedBody: It is on no consumer surface. It is still here because prices and past orders point at it.

meals.title: Meals
meals.subtitle: The dishes on the menu. Publishing one is what a customer can see.
meals.caption: Meals
meals.emptyTitle: This kitchen has no meals yet
meals.emptyBody: Add the first one, or build it from a recipe that is already published.
meals.filteredEmptyBody: Try a shorter search, or allow more statuses.
meals.retireBody: It disappears from the menu, from search and from every meal listing at once. Nothing is deleted: past orders and price-list entries still point at it.
meals.retireConsequence: Withdrawing is this catalogue’s archive for a meal. Publishing it again is a separate, deliberate act.
meals.retireFailed: That meal could not be withdrawn.
meals.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date, or the record belongs to another kitchen.
meals.loadErrorTitle: That meal could not be loaded
meals.createdToast: {{name}} was created as a draft, so no customer can see it yet.
meals.nameRequired: An English name is required before this can be saved.
meals.portionHint: Relative to one recipe serving. Half a serving is 0.5; a serving and a half is 1.5. Changing it rescales the nutrition figures a customer reads.
meals.portionInvalid: The portion must be a number greater than zero.
meals.dietsHint: A preference filter a shopper browses by. Never a medical restriction.
meals.recipeHint: The recipe the meal’s figures and its allergen label come from. A meal with no recipe is bought in, and declares nothing derived.
meals.allergensProvenance: Frozen from recipe version {{version}} when this meal was published. Change the recipe to change the label — it cannot be edited here.
meals.allergensNoProvenance: No recipe version is recorded, so nothing has been derived. Link a recipe to give this meal a label.
meals.channelsReadOnly: Read-only here: this catalogue publishes a channel setter for products and none for meals.
meals.confidentialHint: Margin is kitchen-only. It exists on this record and on no consumer surface anywhere, which is what makes a leak impossible rather than merely forbidden.
meals.marginUnknown: No margin can be stated: either the recipe has no cost or the price is not a confirmed one. A margin over a placeholder price would be a fiction.
meals.publishBody: Publishing is what makes a meal visible outside this kitchen.
meals.publishConsequence: The meal appears on the public menu, in search and on its own page, with the name, description and allergen label below. Withdrawing it later is a separate, deliberate act.
meals.publishAllergensTitle: The label this meal would carry
meals.publishAllergensNone: No allergen is declared. That means either nothing was derived or no recipe is linked — not that the dish is free of all fourteen classes.
meals.publishBlockedTitle: This meal cannot be published yet
meals.blockName: The name is missing one of its two languages.
meals.blockDescription: The description is missing one of its two languages.
meals.blockMealTypes: No meal type is set, so nobody browsing by breakfast or lunch would find it.
meals.blockUnsaved: There are unsaved changes. Save them first — publishing publishes what the server holds, not what is on screen.
meals.publishedTitle: This meal is on the public menu
meals.publishedBody: Every consumer surface reads it now, with the name and label saved here.
meals.publishedToast: {{name}} is published, and customers can see it.
meals.retiredBody: It is on no consumer surface. It is still here because past orders and prices point at it.

priceLists.title: Price lists
priceLists.subtitle: One currency per list. A price a customer can be charged is a confirmed one; nothing else reaches them.
priceLists.caption: Price lists
priceLists.emptyTitle: This kitchen has no price lists yet
priceLists.emptyBody: Price lists arrive with the catalogue import. They cannot be created from this workspace — the management API publishes no create endpoint for them.
priceLists.filteredEmptyBody: Try a shorter search, or allow more statuses.
priceLists.confidentialTitle: Negotiated prices are on this screen
priceLists.confidentialBody: These rates belong inside one buyer relationship. They are never shown outside it, never quoted to another customer, and never reach a public surface.
priceLists.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date, or the record belongs to another kitchen.
priceLists.loadErrorTitle: That price list could not be loaded
priceLists.readOnlyNote: The name, currency, kitchen and channels of a price list are set where it is created and cannot be changed here: the management API publishes no update for them. One list is one currency, and every amount below is in it.
priceLists.entriesHelp: Saving replaces the whole set. A confirmed entry needs an amount; a pending or daily-priced one must not carry one, and the field is cleared and disabled the moment you choose either.
priceLists.unknownItem: An item this kitchen no longer lists
priceLists.itemHint: A product, a dish or a subscription plan from this kitchen.
priceLists.packHint: Each pack of a product is priced separately.
priceLists.variantHint: Price the plan as a whole, or one configuration of it.
priceLists.statusLabel: Why this price is what it is
priceLists.amountHint: In whole {{currency}} and its decimals — 5.50, not 550. Latin digits.
priceLists.amountDisabledHint: No amount is recorded for this status, and none can be.
priceLists.placeholderExplainer: Nobody has decided this price yet. The row is kept so the item is not forgotten, it carries no number, and it never reaches a customer.
priceLists.marketPricedExplainer: This is charged at the day’s market rate. There is no standing number to record, and the row never reaches a customer as a price.
priceLists.effectiveUntilHint: Leave empty for “until it is replaced”.
priceLists.noteHint: Internal. Why this price, or what it is waiting on.
priceLists.itemDuplicate: This list already prices that exact item.
priceLists.amountRequired: A confirmed price needs an amount.
priceLists.amountInvalid: Enter an amount in whole units and the currency’s decimals — 5.50, not 5.505 and not 550.
priceLists.datesReversed: The end date is before the start date.
priceLists.publishBody: Publishing makes its confirmed prices the ones a customer is charged.
priceLists.publishExcludedTitle: What will not reach a customer
priceLists.publishExcludedBody: {{placeholders}} pending and {{market}} daily-priced entries carry no amount. They are excluded from every customer-facing price, before and after this publish — publishing does not turn them into prices.
priceLists.publishBlockedTitle: This price list cannot be published yet
priceLists.blockUnsaved: There are unsaved changes. Save them first — publishing publishes what the server holds, not what is on screen.
priceLists.blockInconsistent_one: {{count}} entry disagrees with its price status.
priceLists.blockInconsistent_other: {{count}} entries disagree with their price status.
priceLists.publishRefusedEntries: The server refused this publish: at least one entry disagrees with its price status. A confirmed price needs an amount, and nothing else may carry one.
priceLists.publishedBody: The confirmed prices on this list are the ones a customer is charged. Pending and daily-priced entries are still excluded.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: A plan is a matrix, a set of commitments and a set of prices. Each of the three can be half-built, and this list says which.
plans.caption: Subscription plans
plans.emptyTitle: This kitchen sells no plans yet
plans.emptyBody: Create the first one, or wait for the import to bring them in.
plans.filteredEmptyBody: Try a shorter search, or allow more statuses.
plans.matrixCaption: Which configurations this plan sells, by combination and energy band
plans.matrixEmpty: This plan has no combinations and no configurations yet. Add a combination below to draw the first row.
plans.variantsHelp: The cells above say which configurations exist; these rows say what each one is. Meals, snacks and the energy band are the cell a configuration sits in, so changing one moves it.
plans.variantsEmpty: Nothing is sold yet. Switch a cell on above.
plans.variantActiveHint: An inactive configuration stays in the catalogue and stops being offered. It is not a deletion — an existing subscription still points at it.
plans.coordinateHint: Together with the energy band, this is the cell of the matrix above.
plans.variantNameRequired: A configuration needs an English name.
plans.servingsRequired: Give the meals and snacks a day. At least one of the two has to be served.
plans.energyRequired: Give both ends of the energy band.
plans.energyReversed: The band runs backwards: the upper figure is below the lower one.
plans.bandAddTitle: A band exists because a configuration carries it
plans.bandAddBody: There is no separate energy-band record in this catalogue. Adding one here draws an empty column so its cells can be switched on; a column nothing is sold in disappears again when this plan is reloaded.
plans.bandAddIncomplete: Give both ends, upper above lower.
plans.bandAddReady: Ready to add as a column.
plans.combinationsHelp: The rows of the matrix — the source material’s “Standard / Premium × meals a day” table. A combination is keyed by its code, which is what a configuration is matched to it by.
plans.combinationsEmpty: No combination is declared. The matrix has no rows until one is.
plans.combinationCodeHint: The kitchen’s own reference, e.g. STANDARD-3M1S. Unique within the plan.
plans.combinationAvailableHint: An unavailable combination keeps its row and its configurations and stops being offered.
plans.combinationCodeDuplicate: Another combination already uses this code. Two rows with one code is ambiguous, and the save replaces the whole set.
plans.combinationLabelRequired: A combination needs an English name.
plans.durationsHelp: How long a commitment runs. A one-off is a single delivery and carries no day count; everything else is a positive number of days, which is what makes 5, 20, 40 and 60 expressible.
plans.durationsEmpty: This plan offers no durations yet.
plans.daysHint: Whole days, at least one. 5, 20, 40 and 60 are the counts the source material uses.
plans.daysAbsentHint: A one-off is a single delivery, so it has no day count at all — not zero, none. Change the kind above to give it one.
plans.daysRequired: A fixed-days duration needs a whole number of days, at least one.
plans.durationDuplicate: This duration is already offered. Two identical rows are one option twice.
plans.discountHint: Leave it empty for “nobody has decided yet”. Type 0 for “this commitment earns nothing”. They are different answers.
plans.discountInvalid: A discount is a whole percent between 0 and 100.
plans.discountNotSetExplainer: No discount has been decided for this duration. It is stored as “unknown”, not as zero.
plans.discountZeroExplainer: This duration earns no discount. That is a decision, not a blank.
plans.pricesHelp: A plan price lives on a price list, not on the plan, so this is read from the lists rather than edited here. It is also what publication is refused for: a plan with no confirmed price would advertise a number nobody has decided.
plans.notFoundTitle: That is not a plan identifier
plans.notFoundBody: A plan is addressed by its identifier, or by “new” for one that does not exist yet.
plans.loadErrorTitle: That plan could not be loaded
plans.matrixHelp: Combinations down the side, energy bands across the top. A cell is sold exactly when a configuration exists in it — there is no separate availability flag, and switching a cell off removes the configurations in it.
plans.createFirst: Save the plan first. Configurations, combinations and durations are edited on the saved record.
plans.nameRequired: A plan needs an English name.
plans.categoriesHint: The slugs a shopper browses by. There is no category list on this contract, so these are the ones the catalogue already uses.
plans.categoriesNone: No plan in this catalogue carries a category yet.
plans.categoryAddHint: Lower case, words joined by hyphens — weight-management.
plans.cutOffHint: Hours before a delivery that a skip or a pause is still accepted. The source rule is 24.
plans.cutOffRequired: Give the cut-off in whole hours.
plans.weekdaysHint: The weekdays this plan can be delivered on. A day left off is a day it never runs.
plans.publishBody: Publishing puts the plan and its configurations in front of every shopper.
plans.publishConsequence_one: {{count}} configuration becomes visible on the plans page, in search and in the subscription flow.
plans.publishConsequence_other: {{count}} configurations become visible on the plans page, in search and in the subscription flow.
plans.publishPricesTitle: What a shopper will be quoted
plans.publishPricesBody: {{confirmed}} of this plan’s priceable rows carry a confirmed price; {{placeholders}} carry none. A row with no confirmed price is never quoted — publishing does not turn one into a price.
plans.publishBlockedTitle: This plan cannot be published yet
plans.blockName: The name is missing one of its two languages.
plans.blockSummary: The summary is missing one of its two languages.
plans.blockVariants: It sells nothing: no cell of the matrix has a configuration in it.
plans.blockDurations: It offers no duration, so there is nothing to commit to.
plans.blockInconsistentDurations_one: {{count}} duration disagrees with its kind: a one-off carries no day count and a fixed-days duration needs a positive one.
plans.blockInconsistentDurations_other: {{count}} durations disagree with their kind: a one-off carries no day count and a fixed-days duration needs a positive one.
plans.blockNoConfirmedPrice: No price list carries a confirmed price for this plan or any of its configurations. Publishing it would advertise a placeholder.
plans.blockUnsaved: There are unsaved changes. Save them first — publishing publishes what the server holds, not what is on screen.
plans.publishRefusedPriceTitle: That publish was refused: no confirmed price
plans.publishedBody: This plan is on the public plans page and can be subscribed to.
plans.retireBody: It disappears from every consumer surface. Nothing is deleted.
plans.retireConsequence: The plan stops being offered and stops appearing in search. Its configurations, durations and history stay, and an existing subscription still points at them.
plans.retiredBody: This plan is not offered anywhere. Nothing was deleted.

zones.title: Delivery zones
zones.subtitle: Where this kitchen delivers, what it charges to get there, and when the van goes out.
zones.caption: Delivery zones
zones.emptyTitle: This kitchen has no delivery zones yet
zones.emptyBody: Add the first one to say where deliveries can go.
zones.filteredEmptyBody: Try a shorter search, or allow more statuses.
zones.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date, or the zone belongs to another kitchen.
zones.loadErrorTitle: That zone could not be loaded
zones.createFirst: Save the zone first. Areas and delivery windows are written against a record that exists.
zones.nameRequired: An English name is required before this can be saved.
zones.currencyCreateHint: Chosen once. A zone's fee and minimum are quoted in it, and it cannot be changed afterwards.
zones.currencyFixedHint: Fixed at creation — the contract has no way to change a zone's currency.
zones.feeHint: What a customer pays for delivery into this zone. Leave it empty if nobody has decided yet.
zones.feeStateUnset: Nothing recorded — this is not the same as free delivery.
zones.feeStateZero: Free delivery, decided. A customer sees no charge.
zones.feeStateAmount: A charge will be shown to the customer.
zones.minimumHint: The smallest order this zone accepts. Leave it empty if there is no rule yet.
zones.minimumStateUnset: Nothing recorded — this is not the same as no minimum.
zones.minimumStateZero: No minimum, decided. Any order size is accepted.
zones.minimumStateAmount: Orders below this amount will be refused.
zones.amountInvalid: Type a plain amount in Latin digits, with no more decimals than the currency has.
zones.estimatedHint: Minutes from order to doorstep, as advertised.
zones.estimatedNone: Nothing recorded — the zone advertises no delivery time.
zones.branchesReadOnly: Read only here: this contract publishes no branch list, and a picker missing a branch would drop it from the zone.
zones.areasIntro: Areas come from the platform gazetteer. A customer address points at one of these rather than carrying free text a match has to guess about.
zones.windowsIntro: One window is one rule — a label, a pair of times and the weekdays it runs on. Splitting it into a row per day is what makes an inconsistent Wednesday possible.
zones.archiveBody: It stops being offered and stays on every order that already used it. Nothing is deleted.
zones.archiveConsequence: A branch only publishes a zone while it is live, so archiving takes this zone off every branch that serves it straight away.
zones.archiveAreaCount_one: {{count}} area stops being reachable through this zone.
zones.archiveAreaCount_other: {{count}} areas stop being reachable through this zone.
zones.archivedBody: It is off every branch that served it. The record stays for the orders that already used it.

areas.selectedNone: None yet. This zone reaches nowhere until an area is chosen.
areas.searchHint: Matches either language and the governorate an area sits in.
areas.moreHidden_one: {{count}} more area matches. Narrow the search to see it.
areas.moreHidden_other: {{count}} more areas match. Narrow the search to see them.
areas.inactive: No longer active in the gazetteer.
areas.unknownArea: An area this workspace has not loaded
areas.truncatedBody: The gazetteer is longer than this screen fetched, so the search below covers what was loaded rather than the whole country.
areas.saveError: Those areas could not be saved.

windows.none: No delivery windows yet. Without one, this zone has no times to offer.
windows.weekdaysHint: One window can span several days. Monday is the first day of the week in every language.
windows.capacityHint: Leave it empty when the kitchen does not cap the window.
windows.capacityUncapped: Uncapped — the window takes as many deliveries as arrive.
windows.activeHint: Turning it off keeps the rule and stops offering the times.
windows.labelRequired: An English window name is required.
windows.startInvalid: The start time must be HH:mm on a 24-hour clock.
windows.endInvalid: The end time must be HH:mm on a 24-hour clock.
windows.endBeforeStart: The end time must be after the start time. A window cannot cross midnight.
windows.capacityInvalid: A capacity is a whole number of deliveries, one or more.
windows.saveError: Those windows could not be saved.

branchHours.title: Opening hours and cut-offs
branchHours.weekIntro: All seven days, always. A closed day is a day somebody has answered, not a day nobody filled in.
branchHours.contextNote: These hours belong to the branch in context. To edit another branch, switch branch from the workspace switcher.
branchHours.closedNote: Closed all day. No hours are recorded and no same-day order is accepted.
branchHours.cutOffHint: The latest a customer can order for delivery today. Leave it empty when there is no cut-off.
branchHours.cutOffNone: No same-day cut-off recorded for this day.
branchHours.copyToOpenDays: Copy these times to every open day
branchHours.opensInvalid: The opening time must be HH:mm on a 24-hour clock.
branchHours.closesInvalid: The closing time must be HH:mm on a 24-hour clock.
branchHours.closesBeforeOpens: The closing time must be after the opening time. A day that runs past midnight cannot be recorded here.
branchHours.cutOffInvalid: The cut-off must be HH:mm on a 24-hour clock.
branchHours.cutOffAfterCloses: The cut-off cannot be after closing time — nobody would be there to cook it.
branchHours.allClosedTitle: This branch is closed every day
branchHours.allClosedBody: Saving this says the branch never trades. If that is not true, open the days it does.
branchHours.saveError: That week could not be saved.
branchHours.savedToast_one: Saved. The branch trades {{count}} day a week.
branchHours.savedToast_other: Saved. The branch trades {{count}} days a week.
branchHours.loadErrorTitle: Those opening hours could not be loaded
branchHours.noBranchBody: Opening hours belong to a branch. Choose one from the workspace switcher and come back.
